# Harbour Town Libraries: Annual Report 2025

Published 14 January 2026 by the Harbour Town Library Board.

## Visits and loans

| Branch    | Visits |        | Loans  |        |
|-----------|--------|--------|--------|--------|
|           | 2024   | 2025   | 2024   | 2025   |
| Northside | 38,900 | 41,200 | 12,400 | 13,050 |
| Eastgate  | 52,300 | 50,100 | 20,800 | 19,900 |
| Quayside  | 17,600 | 21,450 | 6,300  | 7,900  |

Total visits rose from 108,800 to 112,750, an increase of 3.6%. Loans rose
from 39,500 to 40,850.

## Opening hours

From 3 March 2026 all three branches will stay open until 20:00 on weekdays. "We will
extend evening hours at every branch, because most of our readers can only come after
work," said Ingrid Solberg, the board's director. Deputy director Omar Haddad added that
the longer hours will cost about 4% of the staff budget. In a survey of 1,240 evening
visitors, 55–60% said they were adults in work.
